table.name: Developer Immobilizer
table.description: Exact JK00A only. Bit 0 enables ECM immobilizer enforcement; clearing it bypasses the Developer Immobilizer transitions and releases the engine inhibit. NATS DTC suppression is independent. Hardware evidence covers a JK08A-derived image on a 23710-JK00D ECU; no other image carries a hardware result.

table.name: CAN Telemetry at Startup
table.description: Exact JK00A producer configuration. Disabled is the default. A validated START command on the derived control CAN ID overrides this byte until reset; STOP forces streaming off until reset. Requires the project CAN telemetry runtime.

table.name: Cruise Control Switch
table.description: Exact JK00A only. Selects the cruise control steering switch that the ECM decodes. Not Installed: the ECM ignores the steering switch buttons, so the runtime steering-switch gestures, such as the Map Switching selection, have no input. ICC Switch (5 Buttons): the ECM decodes the five-button ICC steering switch with DISTANCE, as stock JK08A does. The switch changes only this byte: cruise control itself also needs an ICC unit and the ICC CAN mailboxes of JK08A, which this byte does not configure. Hardware evidence covers stock JK08A only.

table.name: Rolling Launch Require Accelerator Pedal
table.description: Exact JK00A. Enabled writes min_pedal=1 and requires a nonzero normalized accelerator-pedal signal for activation. Disabled writes min_pedal=0, which makes the pedal gate unconditional. The signal is not presented as a calibrated pedal percentage.
